title: Meta Just Made a #1 AI Ten Times Cheaper Than Opus 4.8
description:
Meta just cut the price of a top-tier AI to four dollars per million output tokens, and thats not a typo 🔥

The model is Muse Spark 1.1, and its ten times cheaper than Opus 4.8 or GPT 5.5 wich run you 25 to 50. And it's not some watered down budget thing either. It topped the MCP Atlas benchmark at 88.1 and Humanity's Last Exam at 62.1, both first place, plus a million token context window ✨

heres the part that actually matters. Meta makes 60+ billion in ad profit a year so it can subsidize AI basically forever and never bleed. Meanwhile the pure play AI labs are watching there margins shrink faster then anyone expected 😅

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
